specification.objective: Make the IPC readiness test independent of the optional TMPDIR environment variable after all CI matrix jobs failed on KeyError: 'TMPDIR', without changing runtime behavior.

requirements.statement: The readiness test explicitly runs with TMPDIR unset and places its Unix socket at a short path inside pytest-managed temporary storage.
The test continues to verify readiness signaling and cleans up the socket without removing pytest-owned parent directories.
The full test suite passes both with TMPDIR unset (CI-equivalent) and with the repository's normal local test environment; production code and dependencies are unchanged.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The readiness test succeeds after removing TMPDIR from its process environment, on all supported CI matrix environments.
The same full-suite characterization command is Green on the locked baseline and target.
POLIS full tests and coverage pass, and CI-equivalent full tests pass with TMPDIR absent.

invariants.statement: No runtime/plugin logic, dependency versions, Hermes configuration, credentials, or memory data are modified.
No test writes directly to /tmp; temporary socket paths are pytest-managed and bounded for AF_UNIX.

forbidden_states.statement: The test requires TMPDIR or fails because the derived socket path exceeds AF_UNIX path limits.
The failure is hidden by skipping the test, weakening readiness assertions, or changing production code.

inputs.statement: CI run 40986812812 on commit e98885e697ded4a16e34ca2c2f53a70cd00481a8 failed all three Hermes matrix jobs at the same KeyError: 'TMPDIR' in test_server_readiness_signal_does_not_depend_on_polling.
The CI runner uses pytest-managed tmp_path under /tmp and does not export TMPDIR.

outputs.statement: A portability fix for the readiness test, with no production behavior changes.

failure_semantics.statement: If CI-equivalent or full-suite validation fails, do not commit or push the fix.
